newsitem.title: USA: US March S&P 500 pierces session high, hits 794.30.
newsitem.headline: US March S&P 500 pierces session high, hits 794.30.

text.p: Feb 7 - U.S. March S&P 500 punched through the day's high at 793.75 late and reached a new session high of 794.30, fueled by bullish momentum after the market rejected midday losses. Traders put resistance at Wednesday's high of 796.60 and at 799.70, the all-time and contract high. ((DerivativesDesk(312)408-8750/E-mail:derivatives@reuters.com))
